title: Select-TTT: Query-Conditioned Selective Fast Weight Updates for In-Place Test-Time Training
title_zh: Select-TTT：面向原位测试时训练的查询条件化选择性快权重更新

paragraphs.en: Test-time training (TTT) enables a deployed language model to internalize incoming context on-the-fly into a small set of fast-weight parameters, rather than merely treating it as transient context for attention. In-Place TTT recently made this idea practical for large language models by repurposing the down-projection of standard MLP blocks as fast weights. However, we find that its benefit largely disappears on realistic web long-context question answering. We attribute this to In-Place TTT’s uniform write schedule: every chunk is written with equal strength, so irrelevant content dilutes query-relevant information in fast-weight memory. Building on this insight, we propose Select-TTT , a model-agnostic, query-conditioned rule for In-Place TTT that scales each chunk’s write strength by its relevance to the user query. This relevance signal requires no supervision and no new parameters: it is read directly from the model’s frozen output head, as the probability mass that a chunk’s hidden states assign to the query tokens. A temperature-scaled softmax turns these scores into learning-rate multipliers, leaving the chunk-wise, context-parallel computation of In-Place TTT intact. Select-TTT consistently improves long-context question answering on two benchmarks and two backbones. These findings highlight the value of query-conditioned fast weight writes for practical test-time training on long-context question answering, which is also potentially promising for long-horizon agent tasks involving multiple user queries over evolving contexts.

paragraphs.en: Large Language Models (LLMs) ( Brown et al., 2020 ; OpenAI et al., 2024 ; Grattafiori et al., 2024 ; Yang et al., 2025a ) are increasingly deployed as web assistants that answer user queries over long, evolving contexts: multi-session dialogue histories, web browsing traces, and lengthy documents ( Wu et al., 2024 ; Maharana et al., 2024 ) . In such scenarios, the static “train then deploy” paradigm faces a double challenge. First, the answer-bearing evidence typically occupies only a tiny fraction of the context, and empirical studies show that LLMs struggle to exploit long contexts even when they nominally fit the context window ( Liu et al., 2024 ; Bai et al., 2025 ; Hsieh et al., 2024 ; Chan et al., 2025 ) . Second, once deployed, the model’s weights are frozen: the model can re- read its context through attention at every step, but it can never internalize it, leaving its parameters misaligned with the information at hand ( Feng et al., 2026 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 大语言模型（LLM）（Brown 等，2020；OpenAI 等，2024；Grattafiori 等，2024；Yang 等，2025a）正被越来越多地部署为网页助手，用以在长且不断演化的上下文中回答用户查询：包括多轮会话的对话历史、网页浏览记录以及长文档（Wu 等，2024；Maharana 等，2024）。 在这类场景中，静态的「先训练后部署」范式面临着双重挑战。 首先，包含答案的证据通常只占上下文的极小一部分，且实证研究表明，即使长上下文在名义上能够装进上下文窗口，大语言模型也难以有效利用它（Liu 等，2024；Bai 等，2025；Hsieh 等，2024；Chan 等，2025）。 其次，模型一经部署，其权重便被冻结：模型可以在每一步通过注意力机制重新读取其上下文，却永远无法将其内化，导致其参数与手头的信息不相匹配（Feng 等，2026）。

paragraphs.en: Two lines of research address these challenges from complementary angles. Architectural approaches extend the context window itself, via sparse or linear attention ( Child et al., 2019 ; Beltagy et al., 2020 ; Zaheer et al., 2020 ; Katharopoulos et al., 2020 ) , state-space models ( Gu et al., 2022 ; Gu and Dao, 2024 ; Dao and Gu, 2024 ) , and positional-embedding scaling ( Su et al., 2023 ; Peng et al., 2024 ) . Test-Time Training (TTT) ( Sun et al., 2020 ; Wang et al., 2021 ; Sun et al., 2025 ; Behrouz et al., 2025 ) , in contrast, makes the model itself adaptive: it designates a small subset of parameters — the fast weights ( Schmidhuber, 1992 ; Ba et al., 2016 ) — as a dynamic memory that is updated on the fly while processing the input, internalizing contextual information as it arrives. Among TTT methods, In-Place TTT (IP-TTT) ( Feng et al., 2026 ) is of particular practical interest: it repurposes the final projection matrix of the ubiquitous gated MLP blocks as fast weights, pairs this with an objective aligned with Next-Token Prediction (NTP), and organizes updates chunk-wise so that TTT becomes a “drop-in” enhancement compatible with context parallelism — requiring no architectural modification and no training from scratch.
paragraphs.zh: 两条研究路线从互补的角度应对这些挑战。 架构方法通过稀疏或线性注意力（Child et al., 2019；Beltagy et al., 2020；Zaheer et al., 2020；Katharopoulos et al., 2020）、状态空间模型（Gu et al., 2022；Gu and Dao, 2024；Dao and Gu, 2024）以及位置嵌入缩放（Su et al., 2023；Peng et al., 2024）来扩展上下文窗口本身。 与之相对，测试时训练（TTT）（Sun et al., 2020；Wang et al., 2021；Sun et al., 2025；Behrouz et al., 2025）使模型本身具有自适应性：它指定一小部分参数——即快速权重（Schmidhuber, 1992；Ba et al., 2016）——作为在处理输入时即时更新的动态记忆，在上下文信息到达时将其内化。 在 TTT 方法中，原位测试时训练（IP-TTT）（Feng et al., 2026）尤其具有现实意义：它将无处不在的门控 MLP 块的最终投影矩阵改造为快速权重，将其与对齐下一词元预测（NTP）的目标相结合，并按分块方式组织更新，使 TTT 成为一种与上下文并行兼容的“即插即用”增强——无需任何架构修改，也无需从头训练。

paragraphs.en: However, the IP-TTT’s write schedule is uniform: every chunk updates the fast weights with the same learning rate, regardless of its content. This is at odds with how long-context question answering works in practice. When a question concerns a small portion of a long history, the chunks that carry the answer are written with the same strength as the many chunks that do not, and the noise accumulated from irrelevant writes dilutes the query-relevant information in the fast-weight memory. Empirically, we find that uniform In-Place TTT brings little or no improvement on realistic long-context QA benchmarks, and sometimes degrades the zero-shot performance. A controlled experiment with oracle annotations confirms the diagnosis: amplifying the writes of answer chunks improves accuracy markedly, whereas amplifying the writes of irrelevant chunks drives it below the baseline (Figure 1 ).
paragraphs.zh: 然而，IP-TTT 的写入调度是均匀的：每个分块都以相同的学习率更新快权重，而不考虑其内容。 这与长上下文问答在实际中的工作方式相悖。 当问题仅涉及长历史中的一小部分时，承载答案的分块与众多无关分块以相同的强度被写入，来自无关写入所累积的噪声会稀释快权重记忆中与查询相关的信息。 实验上，我们发现均匀的原地 TTT（In-Place TTT）在现实的长上下文问答基准上几乎或完全没有带来提升，有时甚至会降低零样本性能。 一项带有预言标注（oracle annotations）的受控实验证实了这一诊断：放大答案分块的写入能显著提高准确率，而放大无关分块的写入则会使准确率降至基线以下（图 1）。

paragraphs.en: We solve this question affirmatively with Select-TTT , a query-conditioned selective update rule for In-Place TTT. Our key observation is that a pre-trained LLM already carries a well-calibrated relevance measure — its own output head. Select-TTT scores each chunk in the logit space : it maps the chunk’s hidden states through the frozen output head and measures the probability mass they assign to the query tokens (the query-conditioned cross-entropy). A low query-CE indicates that the local representation is already predictive of the question, i.e., the chunk is relevant. Chunk-level scores, aggregated by top- k k mean pooling, are converted into per-chunk learning-rate multipliers via a temperature-scaled softmax designed to meet three desiderata: soft writes (every chunk receives a positive multiplier, so potentially answer-bearing chunks are never entirely discarded), budget preservation (only the distribution across chunks changes, conserving the total amount of information written), and stability (an upper clip prevents any single chunk from dominating). The resulting rule merely rescales each chunk’s update by a scalar, and reduces to IP-TTT when no query is present.
paragraphs.zh: 我们通过 Select-TTT 对这个问题给出肯定的回答，这是一种面向原地 TTT 的查询条件化选择性更新规则。 我们的关键观察是，预训练的大语言模型本身已经携带了一个校准良好的相关性度量——它自己的输出头。 Select-TTT 在 logit 空间中对每个分块打分：它将分块的隐藏状态通过冻结的输出头进行映射，并度量输出头分配给查询 token 的概率质量（即查询条件化交叉熵）。 较低的查询交叉熵表明局部表征已经能够预测问题，即该分块是相关的。 分块级别的分数通过 top- k k 均值池化进行聚合，再经由一个温度缩放的 softmax 转换为逐分块的学习率乘数，该设计满足三个目标：软写入（每个分块都获得正的乘数，因此可能承载答案的分块绝不会被完全丢弃）、预算保持（只有分块之间的分布发生变化，从而保持写入的信息总量不变）以及稳定性（上限截断防止任何单个分块占据主导）。 所得到的规则仅仅是用一个标量重新缩放每个分块的更新，并且在没有查询存在时退化为 IP-TTT。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate Select-TTT on two long-context QA benchmarks, LongMemEval-S ( Wu et al., 2024 ) and LoCoMo ( Maharana et al., 2024 ) , with Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct and Qwen3-4B backbones, under two protocols: applying the selective rule only at inference on an In-Place TTT checkpoint, and enabling it during continual training on LongCite-45k ( Zhang et al., 2025a ) as well. In both settings Select-TTT consistently outperforms uniform In-Place TTT and the corresponding baselines. Ablations show that each component of the multiplier design contributes. All these findings highlight the value of query-conditioned fast weight writes for practical test-time training.

paragraphs.en: While In-Place TTT has been shown effective on synthetic retrieval benchmarks such as RULER ( Hsieh et al., 2024 ; Feng et al., 2026 ) , we observe that its benefit on long-context user QA under realistic web scenarios is marginal. Concretely, on LongMemEval-S ( Wu et al., 2024 ) , a comprehensive and challenging benchmark for testing the long-term memory of chat assistants, enabling In-Place TTT with the Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct backbone raises the average accuracy only from 33.4 % 33.4\% (zero-shot Baseline) to 33.6 % 33.6\% . We hypothesize that the cause is the indiscriminate write of In-Place TTT: the update of Eq. ( 5 ) applies the same learning rate η \eta to every chunk, so chunks irrelevant to the user query are written into the fast weights with equal strength as the answer-bearing chunks, and their noise dilutes the query-relevant information in the memory.
paragraphs.zh: 虽然原地 TTT 已在诸如 RULER（Hsieh et al., 2024；Feng et al., 2026）等合成检索基准上被证明有效，但我们观察到，在真实网页场景下的长上下文用户问答中，其收益微乎其微。 具体而言，在 LongMemEval-S（Wu et al., 2024）这一用于测试聊天助手长期记忆的全面且具有挑战性的基准上，为 Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct 主干启用原地 TTT 仅将平均准确率从 33.4 % 33.4\%（零样本基线）提升到 33.6 % 33.6\%。 我们推测其原因在于原地 TTT 的不加区分的写入：公式 （5）对每个分块都应用相同的学习率 η \eta，因此与用户查询无关的分块会以与包含答案的分块同等的强度被写入快速权重，其噪声稀释了记忆中与查询相关的信息。

paragraphs.en: Figure 1 reports the results, and two trends are clear. (a) Holding the irrelevant-chunk learning rate fixed, strengthening the write of answer chunks improves accuracy monotonically, from 33.6 % 33.6\% (the uniform In-Place TTT setting) to 37.8 % 37.8\% . (b) Conversely, increasing the write strength of irrelevant chunks progressively degrades accuracy, from 34.8 % 34.8\% down to 29.6 % 29.6\% . These two trends reveal a key limitation of uniform In-Place TTT: the writes from irrelevant chunks actively hurt performance, while stronger writes to answer chunks help. Then a practical question arises: in realistic QA scenarios, how can we know in advance which chunks contain the answer? A natural thought is: if each chunk’s write strength could be scaled by its relevance to the query — amplifying answer-bearing chunks and suppressing irrelevant ones — the fast-weight memory would tend to retain the information the model actually needs. Motivated by this idea, we propose Select-TTT in the next section.

paragraphs.en: A key challenge is that fast weight updates in In-Place TTT are carried out entirely within the gated MLP, so the only signal available for chunk i i is its own hidden state 𝐇 [ i ] \mathbf{H}_{[i]} , which carries no direct notion of relevance to the query. The chunks in Select-TTT are instead contiguous segments of a single input, represented solely by the model’s intermediate hidden states produced online during the forward pass.

paragraphs.en: We evaluate our method on two widely adopted long-context QA benchmarks that cover complementary aspects of long-term memory. LongMemEval-S ( Wu et al., 2024 ) focuses on interactive memory in multi-session user-assistant dialogues, where information is accumulated across sessions and may evolve over time. It contains 500 questions embedded in histories of approximately 40 sessions and 115K tokens each, and comprises six subtasks. LoCoMo ( Maharana et al., 2024 ) , in contrast, tests reasoning over very long conversations that span up to 35 sessions and roughly 300 turns per dialogue, with a total of around 1,980 questions distributed across 10 dialogues. Together, these benchmarks allow us to assess both multi-session consistency and long-context retrieval under a unified setup. For continual-training experiments, we use LongCite-45k ( Zhang et al., 2025a ) , a large-scale corpus of 44,600 long-context QA instances (up to 128K tokens) which provides a natural source of query-context pairs for training.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在两个广泛采用的长上下文问答基准上评估我们的方法，这两个基准涵盖了长期记忆的互补方面。 LongMemEval-S（Wu 等，2024）专注于多轮用户-助手对话中的交互式记忆，其中信息跨会话积累并可能随时间演变。 它包含 500 个嵌入在约 40 个会话、每个约 115K token 历史中的问题，并包含六个子任务。 相比之下，LoCoMo（Maharana 等，2024）测试对跨越多达 35 个会话、每个对话约 300 轮的超长对话的推理，共有约 1,980 个问题分布在 10 个对话中。 这些基准共同使我们能够在统一设置下评估多会话一致性和长上下文检索。 对于持续训练实验，我们使用 LongCite-45k（Zhang 等，2025a），这是一个包含 44,600 个长上下文问答实例（最多 128K token）的大规模语料库，为训练提供了天然的查询-上下文对来源。

paragraphs.en: We consider two complementary protocols. Protocol I (inference-time Select-TTT). The Select-TTT chunk-wise updates of Eq. ( 6 ) are applied only at inference-time. We compare: (i) Baseline — the original pre-trained LLM evaluated directly, without any test-time update; (ii) IP-TTT — In-Place TTT with a uniform learning rate, i.e., λ i = 1 \lambda_{i}=1 for all chunks i i ; and (iii) Select-TTT — our query-conditioned multipliers (Eq. ( 10 )). Methods (ii) and (iii) are run on the same TTT-enhanced checkpoint, obtained by following the original recipe of In-Place TTT; the two rows differ only in whether the per-chunk multiplier is uniform or query-conditioned, so their contrast cleanly isolates the effect of query-conditioned selective mechanism. Protocol II (selective continual training). The model is continually trained for up to 5 5 k steps on the processed LongCite-45k corpus with the TTT mechanism active during training, and evaluated on LongMemEval-S at every 1k-step checkpoint with the same mechanism active at inference. We compare: (i) CPT — standard continual pre-training on the same corpus without any TTT mechanism; (ii) IP-TTT — continual training with uniform TTT updates ( λ i = 1 \lambda_{i}=1 ); and (iii) Select-TTT — continual training with the selective mechanism. For TTT-based training, both the backbone parameters and the newly introduced TTT parameters are updated jointly so that the model adapts its TTT behavior to the long-context QA setting, whereas CPT follows the vanilla fine-tuning recipe. We also report the No-Training reference, i.e., the zero-shot performance before any continual training.

paragraphs.en: Select-TTT attains the best average score on both benchmarks and both backbones: on LongMemEval-S it improves over IP-TTT by + 3.8 +3.8 (Llama) and + 3.4 +3.4 (Qwen), and over the Baseline by + 4.0 +4.0 and + 1.6 +1.6 respectively; on LoCoMo it reaches 40.42 40.42 (Llama) and 26.19 26.19 (Qwen), again the highest among the three methods. More revealing is the relative behavior of the two TTT variants. The uniform adaptation of IP-TTT does not consistently help in this zero-shot long-context QA scenario: on Qwen3-4B it drops the LongMemEval-S average from 27.2 27.2 to 25.4 25.4 , and on Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct from 39.55 39.55 to 38.90 38.90 . This indicates that In-Place TTT writes every chunk into the fast weights with equal strength dilutes query-relevant information, as irrelevant chunks contribute noise on equal footing with relevant ones. Simply replacing the uniform schedule with query-conditioned multipliers on the same checkpoint yields a consistent gain: by suppressing the write strength of query-irrelevant chunks while reinforcing that of relevant ones, Select-TTT achieves the best performance across both backbones and both benchmarks.
paragraphs.zh: Select-TTT 在两个基准和两个骨干模型上均取得最佳平均分数：在 LongMemEval-S 上，它比 IP-TTT 提升 +3.8（Llama）和 +3.4（Qwen），比基线分别提升 +4.0 和 +1.6；在 LoCoMo 上，它达到 40.42（Llama）和 26.19（Qwen），同样在三种方法中最高。 更能说明问题的是两种 TTT 变体的相对表现。 IP-TTT 的均匀适配在这种零样本长上下文问答场景中并不总是有帮助：在 Qwen3-4B 上，它使 LongMemEval-S 平均分从 27.2 降至 25.4，在 Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct 上从 39.55 降至 38.90。 这表明 In-Place TTT 以同等强度将每个片段写入快速权重，稀释了与查询相关的信息，因为无关片段与相关片段以同等地位贡献噪声。 仅需在同一检查点上用查询条件化的乘子替换均匀调度即可带来一致的提升：通过抑制与查询无关片段的写入强度并增强相关片段的写入强度，Select-TTT 在两个骨干模型和两个基准上均取得最佳性能。

paragraphs.en: A final ablation examines the two safeguards built into the multiplier of Eq. ( 10 ) (Table 3 ). The softmax realizes a soft write : the query-CE ranking is only an estimate of relevance, so writing every chunk with a strength proportional to its estimated relevance ensures that answer-bearing chunks are never entirely skipped. The clip, in turn, guards against over-writes: an extremely confident chunk would otherwise attract a multiplier far beyond the average budget and be written into the fast weights too aggressively. The result in Table 3 shows that removing both components causes a performance drop. Both safeguards are empirically necessary.

To rule out the possibility that a standard retrieval signal would serve equally well despite the mismatch argued in Section 4.2 , we compare the query-CE score of Eq. ( 9 ) with two representative alternatives: Cosine similarity between the mean-pooled chunk and query hidden states; and a pretrained Cross-encoder bge-reranker ( Xiao et al., 2024b ) consuming the hidden states. On LongMemEval-S QA instances with ground-truth answer-chunk annotations, we rank the chunks under each signal across different chunk sizes and measure Hit@ k k — whether at least one of the k k highest-ranked chunks contains the answer and Rec@ k k — the fraction of answer chunks they cover.

paragraphs.en: Fast weights, network parameters updated on the fly to act as a dynamic memory, date back to the early nineties ( Schmidhuber, 1992 ; Ba et al., 2016 ) and were revived by linear transformers ( Ba et al., 2016 ; Katharopoulos et al., 2020 ) . Test-time training was introduced in computer vision as a means of adapting to distribution shift ( Sun et al., 2020 ; Wang et al., 2021 ) and has since been scaled to language modeling, both as standalone sequence models ( Sun et al., 2025 ; Behrouz et al., 2025 ; Karami et al., 2025 ; Zhang et al., 2025b ) and, most recently, as an in-place enhancement of pre-trained LLMs ( Feng et al., 2026 ) . Research has concentrated on the update objective, the optimizer, and the parallelization of the inherently sequential per-token updates ( Sun et al., 2023 ; Irie and Gershman, 2026 ; Yau et al., 2026 ) . In all of these methods, however, the write schedule is fixed in advance: every token or chunk is written with the same strength, independently of its relevance to the task the model is being asked to perform.
paragraphs.zh: 快速权重（fast weights），即在运行中动态更新以充当动态记忆的网络参数，可追溯至二十世纪九十年代初（Schmidhuber, 1992；Ba et al., 2016），并在后来由线性Transformer（Ba et al., 2016；Katharopoulos et al., 2020）重新焕发生机。 测试时训练最初在计算机视觉中被引入，作为应对分布偏移的一种手段（Sun et al., 2020；Wang et al., 2021），此后被扩展到语言建模，既可以作为独立的序列模型（Sun et al., 2025；Behrouz et al., 2025；Karami et al., 2025；Zhang et al., 2025b），最近又被用作预训练大语言模型的原位增强（Feng et al., 2026）。 相关研究集中于更新目标、优化器，以及本质上逐token顺序更新过程的并行化（Sun et al., 2023；Irie and Gershman, 2026；Yau et al., 2026）。 然而，在所有这些方法中，写入调度都是预先固定的：每个token或分块都以相同的强度写入，而与模型被要求完成的任务的相关性无关。

paragraphs.en: A parallel line of work attacks the quadratic cost of attention ( Vaswani et al., 2017 ) directly, through sparse attention patterns ( Child et al., 2019 ; Beltagy et al., 2020 ; Zaheer et al., 2020 ) , streaming attention with sinks ( Xiao et al., 2024a ) , IO-aware exact attention ( Dao et al., 2022 ) , linear attention ( Katharopoulos et al., 2020 ; Ba et al., 2016 ) , and state-space models ( Gu et al., 2022 ; Gu and Dao, 2024 ; Dao and Gu, 2024 ; Yang et al., 2024 ) , complemented by positional-embedding scaling ( Su et al., 2023 ; Peng et al., 2024 ) and segment-level recurrence ( Dai et al., 2019 ) . These methods make long inputs processable, yet benchmark studies show that the context models actually exploit falls well short of the advertised window ( Liu et al., 2024 ; Bai et al., 2025 ; Hsieh et al., 2024 ) . Test-time adaptation is orthogonal to this line: rather than processing the context more cheaply, it changes what the model retains from the context, and the two can be combined.
paragraphs.zh: 另一条平行的研究路线直接针对注意力机制（Vaswani et al., 2017）的二次方开销展开攻击，包括稀疏注意力模式（Child et al., 2019；Beltagy et al., 2020；Zaheer et al., 2020）、带汇点的流式注意力（Xiao et al., 2024a）、IO 感知的精确注意力（Dao et al., 2022）、线性注意力（Katharopoulos et al., 2020；Ba et al., 2016）以及状态空间模型（Gu et al., 2022；Gu and Dao, 2024；Dao and Gu, 2024；Yang et al., 2024），此外还有位置嵌入缩放（Su et al., 2023；Peng et al., 2024）和分段级循环（Dai et al., 2019）作为补充。 这些方法使长输入变得可处理，然而基准研究表明，上下文模型实际能够利用的上下文远低于其宣称的窗口大小（Liu et al., 2024；Bai et al., 2025；Hsieh et al., 2024）。 测试时自适应与这条路线是正交的：它并非以更低成本处理上下文，而是改变模型从上下文中保留的内容，二者可以结合使用。

paragraphs.en: Equipping language models with memory has a long history, from retrieval over external corpora ( Khandelwal et al., 2020 ; Guu et al., 2020 ; Lewis et al., 2020 ) and dedicated memory modules ( Graves et al., 2014 ; Rae et al., 2019 ; Dai et al., 2019 ) to recent memory systems for conversational assistants ( Packer et al., 2024 ; Zhong et al., 2024 ; Chhikara et al., 2025 ; Wang et al., 2024 ; Yu et al., 2026 ) . These systems keep memory outside the model’s parameters and decide what to read at answer time, typically through similarity retrieval. A complementary mechanism operates inside linear-recurrent models, where data-dependent gates control what a parametric state retains ( Gu and Dao, 2024 ; Yang et al., 2025b ) .
paragraphs.zh: 为语言模型配备记忆有着悠久的历史，从对外部语料库进行检索（Khandelwal et al., 2020；Guu et al., 2020；Lewis et al., 2020）、专用记忆模块（Graves et al., 2014；Rae et al., 2019；Dai et al., 2019），到最近面向对话助手的记忆系统（Packer et al., 2024；Zhong et al., 2024；Chhikara et al., 2025；Wang et al., 2024；Yu et al., 2026）。 这些系统将记忆保存在模型参数之外，并在回答时决定读取哪些内容，通常通过相似性检索来实现。 一种互补的机制运行于线性递归模型内部，其中依赖于数据的门控控制参数化状态所保留的内容（Gu and Dao, 2024；Yang et al., 2025b）。

paragraphs.en: We introduced Select-TTT, which applies a query-conditioned selective learning-rate rule that scores each chunk in the logit space of the frozen output head and rescales its fast-weight write accordingly. The rule is a drop-in enhancement that preserves the chunk-wise, context-parallel computation of IP-TTT and adds only a lightweight scoring pass. This provides a novel model-internal way to select hidden states when conventional text-based retrieval signals are unavailable or poorly matched. Across two backbones and two benchmarks, Select-TTT consistently improves over IP-TTT and zero-shot baselines, both as an inference-time enhancement and when coupled with continual training. We see Select-TTT as a step toward query-aware test-time memory, and expect the principle — conditioning what is written on why it is being written — to extend to other test-time adaptation mechanisms and to agentic web applications where long, evolving contexts are the norm.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了 Select-TTT，它采用一种以查询为条件的门控学习率规则：在冻结输出头的 logit 空间中对每个分块打分，并据此重新缩放其快权重的写入幅度。 该规则是一种即插即用的增强方法，既保留了 IP-TTT 按分块、上下文并行的计算方式，又只增加了一次轻量的打分过程。 当传统的基于文本的检索信号不可用或匹配效果不佳时，这提供了一种新颖的模型内部方式来选择隐藏状态。 在两个骨干模型和两个基准上，Select-TTT 无论是作为推理时增强还是与持续训练相结合，都始终优于 IP-TTT 和零样本基线。 我们将 Select-TTT 视为迈向查询感知测试时记忆的一步，并期望这一原则——根据写入的目的来决定写入的内容——能够推广到其他测试时自适应机制，以及以长且不断演化的上下文为常态的智能体式网络应用中。

paragraphs.en: Select-TTT conditions its memory writes on the user query, and the logit-space query-CE is only a heuristic estimate of chunk relevance: the scoring rule applies the frozen LM head to states from multiple TTT layers, potentially affecting the calibration of their query-token scores. A learned relevance function is a promising direction but may introduce additional computation, parameters, and training overhead. Our fixed chunk size follows the IP-TTT setting to preserve context parallelism. Semantically adaptive chunking could yield better boundaries and relevance estimates. Our evaluation covers two backbones of up to 8B parameters and two English benchmarks; scaling to larger models, multilingual settings, and other modalities remains future work.

paragraphs.en: This appendix gives the complete context-parallel implementation of Select-TTT in Algorithm 1 . For each chunk, the algorithm computes a query-conditioned relevance score and the standard In-Place TTT update in parallel. It then converts the scores into learning-rate multipliers, aggregates the weighted updates with a causal prefix sum, and applies only preceding updates when producing each chunk’s output.
paragraphs.zh: 本附录给出了算法 1 中 Select-TTT 的完整上下文并行实现。 对于每个分块，该算法并行计算以查询为条件的 relevence 相关性得分以及标准的原地 TTT 更新。 随后，算法将这些得分转换为学习率乘数，通过因果前缀和聚合加权更新，并在生成每个分块的输出时仅应用之前的更新。

paragraphs.en: LongMemEval-S is a benchmark for long-term interactive memory in chat assistants. It contains 500 500 questions over timestamped histories of approximately 40 40 sessions and 115 115 K tokens. Its six question types are knowledge update, multi-session, temporal reasoning, single-session user, single-session assistant, and single-session preference. We use the public benchmark and follow its official per-subtask accuracy protocol. LoCoMo evaluates very long-term conversational memory. The public ten-dialogue release contains 1,986 1{,}986 questions over 19–32 sessions and 369–689 turns per dialogue. Its five query types are single-hop, multi-hop, temporal, open-domain, and adversarial reasoning. We use the public dialogues and report overall score by query type.

paragraphs.en: LongCite-45k ( Zhang et al., 2025a ) is a corpus of approximately 44,600 44{,}600 long-context QA instances with sentence-level citation annotations, designed to train models to answer questions and identify supporting context spans. It was constructed using the Coarse-to-Fine (CoF) pipeline and contains both Chinese and English examples. To maintain data quality and keep the CPT corpus consistent with our long-context English evaluation benchmarks, we retain only English examples whose context lengths are in the 8 8 K– 65 65 K token range. We use this filtered English subset for all CPT experiments.
paragraphs.zh: LongCite-45k（Zhang et al., 2025a）是一个包含约 44{,}600 个带句子级引用标注的长上下文问答实例的语料库，旨在训练模型回答问题并识别支持性上下文片段。 它采用由粗到细（CoF）流水线构建，同时包含中文和英文样本。 为了保持数据质量并使 CPT 语料库与我们的长上下文英文评测基准保持一致，我们仅保留上下文长度在 8K–65K token 范围内的英文样本。 我们在所有 CPT 实验中都使用这个过滤后的英文子集。
